scope: Reviewed single-armor default for the common HealthPercentageDamage warhead; no installed-DLL or complete combat certification.
interpretation: HealthPercentageDamageWarhead inherits TargetDamageWarhead and calls inherited DamageVersus. DamageVersus starts at 100 and applies only matching armor entries. Therefore a missing named armor has factor 100, while an explicit zero remains zero. Damage uses HealthInfo.HP and is a percentage of maximum HP, not flat HP.
limitations: This covers the common HealthPercentageDamage type only, not custom HealthPercentageSpreadDamage or clamped HP models.
Abstract armor curves assume one active named armor and an eligible healthy target; multiple armor traits, integer rounding, mitigation and target state are separate.
Source bindings must match retained matrix engine-default proof hashes before applying this supplemental default. Raw source exports are not rewritten.
